stem:
Devansh fills a closed plastic bottle with water. He makes a small hole in the side wall near the bottom. Water streams out sideways through the hole.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Water flowing out the side hole shows that the liquid pushes on the side walls as well as downward.
A fluid in a closed container exerts pressure on the bottom and on the side walls.
Water pushes only straight down on the bottom, so a side hole cannot release water.
The closed cap alone stops all pressure on the side walls.

teacher.key_rationale: Sideways flow from a wall hole shows liquid pressure acts on the sides, not only downward. A closed cap does not remove side-wall pressure.
